title: listings.bookables
description: Keyed batch of listings as bookables (the stapel-reservations resolver contract): listings.purchasables with unpriced listings included. Output: {key: {title, price, currency, available, max_quantity, seller_id, image, url}}; price is a 2-dp decimal string, or null for an unpriced listing (a free reservation); available is visibility alone (a published, visible listing; never the stock count or inventory, capacity is the reservations schedule) and max_quantity is always null; absent keys are unknown (no such listing or soft-deleted).
